name: Carina Inc
old_description: We are highly experienced, private label, garment manufacturers specializing in leather + shearling production in NYC.
about:
Carina Inc operates from New York City's Garment District at 242 West 38th Street. The company was established in January 1996 by Alfred Sabetay, who began his career in the late 1960s learning fur and shearling production from his father in Queens. After opening a first facility with a partner in 1973, Sabetay branched out on his own to create Carina New York, and his daughter Paula Stvan joined the following year. The business remains family-owned and operated.

The company provides private-label garment manufacturing with a focus on leather, shearling, and denim. Its in-house factory offers three service tiers: cut-and-sew only (client supplies patterns and materials), cut-and-sew with pattern development and grading, and full-service production that includes pattern work, muslin prototypes, fittings, material sourcing, and final assembly. Production minimums start at 50 pieces, though they vary for denim and cotton programs.

Carina serves fashion brands ranging from startups to established labels, producing apparel, outerwear, sportswear, ready-to-wear, runway pieces, bespoke items, accessories, and home goods. The client roster includes recognizable designer labels, though specific names are not disclosed.

The firm emphasizes craftsmanship, attention to detail, and on-time delivery as hallmarks of its family legacy. It also runs an upcycling program that turns fabric scraps into accessories, embellishments, and small home goods, offering brands an environmentally conscious production option.
